$comment: The gate contract. Every entry is measurable or binary. A gate that cannot fail is decoration; mfe demo --selftest proves these can.

gates.name: render exists
gates.pass: decodes, non-blank, duration within max(1%, 0.35s) of the plan, audio stream present
gates.catches: a render that completed but is truncated, empty, or silent

gates.name: delivery shape
gates.pass: display width x height and fps equal the profile; codec and pixel format correct
gates.catches: a vertical edit sized as landscape from rotation metadata; wrong fps; odd dimensions

gates.name: loudness
gates.pass: |integrated - target| <= 2 LU and true peak <= -1 dBTP + 0.1
gates.catches: the silent-quiet render that passes every visual check

gates.name: picture alive
gates.pass: no freeze > 0.5s and no stretch > max_dead_stretch_s with no visual change
gates.catches: a frozen frame, a stalled scene, a slide pretending to be a film

gates.name: no black holes
gates.catches: a gap between segments, a source that did not decode

gates.name: cuts don't pop
gates.pass: no boundary spike > 6 dB over the local body level within 120ms of a cut, and no peak above -6 dBFS there
gates.measured_by: tools/mfe.py gate (astats peak vs local RMS)
gates.catches: a missing 30ms micro-fade: audible clicks at every cut

gates.name: captions safe
gates.pass: every cue box inside the profile safe zone; caption text height >= 3.5% of frame height
gates.measured_by: tools/mfe.py gate + caption boxes from tools/mfe.py captions
gates.catches: text under the platform UI, captions over the mouth, unreadable caption size

gates.name: honest proof
gates.pass: every asset declares origin in provenance.json; nothing with claims_reality=true is generated
gates.catches: a generated image implying a screenshot of a real product

gates.name: pace
gates.pass: no stretch longer than max_static_s (3.5 s) without a visible change, for any piece under 90 s — from the pacing rule in tiktok-short-edit: something changes every 2-3 s
gates.measured_by: mfe.py gate — ffmpeg scene detection, so a moving subject is not counted as an edit
gates.skip_when: over 90 s; long-form sets its own pace

gates.name: reference match
gates.pass: aspect within 0.04 of the reference and at least 60% of lit pixels inside its palette (40% fails)
gates.measured_by: mfe.py gate --style, spec from mfe.py style
gates.note: measures form only: it cannot tell whether the graphics carry content

gates.name: design gates
gates.pass: nine binary checks: renders, legibility, hierarchy, one system, specificity, content reality, states, accessibility, one deviation

policy.on_unsatisfiable_gate: state it in the report with the reason; never fake the number and never silently skip
handoff_requires: the one warning kept and why
